title: Placed Consumer Accounts Credit-Card Payments: Plans Closed as Broken and Not Reinstated
content:
Payments risk memorandum clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the plan-cancellation percentage of the credit-card ceiling of the day, read from the account's Payment Arrangements records.

## Clause

The credit-card ceiling's plan-cancellation percentage is:
- **80%** where the most recent closing of a payment plan on the account with close reason "broken, not reinstated" falls in the last 3 months;
- **90%** where that most recent such closing falls 3 or more months before the handling date;
- **100%** where no payment plan on the account was closed with that close reason.

The card limit of the credit-card ceiling is multiplied by the plan-cancellation percentage; the percentage applies to the card limit alone.

## Reading the clause

- The record read is the Payment Arrangements plan record of the placed account: its close reason and its closed date. Only plans closed with the close reason "broken, not reinstated" count; a plan closed as completed, cancelled by the consumer or for any other reason does not.
- Where several plans on the account were closed that way, the most recent closed date decides.
- A closing falls in the last 3 months when fewer than three whole calendar months separate its closed date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month.

| Handling date 2026-10-10: closed date of the most recent such plan | Whole months | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-11 | 2 | 80% |
| 2026-07-10 | 3 | 90% |
| 2025-12-01 | 10 | 90% |
| No plan closed as broken, not reinstated | not applicable | 100% |

## Hypothetical illustration

*Invented records.* An account had a Short-Term Installment Plan closed as broken, not reinstated on 2026-02-03 and a Standard Installment Plan closed the same way on 2026-08-28. On a handling date of 2026-10-10 the most recent such closing, 2026-08-28, is fewer than three whole months back, so the percentage is 80%; a hypothetical card limit of $3000.00 is then taken at $2400.00.
